κύριος.sd: supreme in authority, i.e. (as noun) controller; by implication, Master (as a respectful title)
κύριος.as:
κύριος, -α, -ον (also -ος, -ον),
[in LXX (subst.) chiefly for יהוה, also for אָדוֹן, בַּעַל, etc.;]
having power (κῦρος) or authority; as subst., ὁ κ., lord, master;
1. in general: c. gen. rei, Mt 9:3820:8, Mk 12:913:35, Lk 19:33; τ. σαββάτου, Mt 12:8, Mk 2:28, Lk 6:5; c. gen. pers., δούλου, etc., Mt 10:24, Lk 14:21, Ac 16:16, al.; absol., opp. to οἱ δοῦλοι, Eph 6:5, 9, al.; of the Emperor (Deiss., LAE, 161), Ac 25:26; θεοὶ πολλοὶ καὶ κ. πολλοί, I Co 8:5; of a husband, I Pe 3:6; in voc., as a title of respect to masters, teachers, magistrates, etc., Mt 13:2716:2227:63, Mk 7:28, Lk 5:12, Jo 4:11, Ac 9:5, al.
2. As a divine title (freq. in π.; Deiss., LAE, 353 ff.); in NT,
(a) of God: ὁ κ., Mt 5:33, Mk 5:19, Lk 1:6, Ac 7:33, He 8:2, Ja 4:15, al.; anarth. (Bl., § 46, 6), Mt 21:9, Mk 13:20, Lk 1:17, He 7:21, I Pe 1:25, al.; κ. τ. οὐρανοῦ καὶ τ. γῆς, Mt 11:25; τ. κυριευόντων, I Ti 6:15; κ. ὁ θεός, Mt 4:7, 10 al.; id. seq. ὁ παντοκράτωρ, Re 4:8; κ. σαβαώθ, Ro 9:29; (ὁ) ἄγγελος κυρίου, Mt 1:202:13, Lk 1:11, al.; πνεῦμα κυρίου, Lk 4:18, Ac 8:39;
(b) of the Christ: Mt 21:3, Mk 11:3, Lk 1:4320:44, al.; of Jesus after his resurrection (Dalman, Words, 330), Ac 10:36, Ro 14:8, I Co 7:22, Eph 4:5, al.; ὁ κ. μου, Jo 20:28; ὁ κ. Ἰησοῦς, Ac 1:21, I Co 11:23, al.; id. seq. Χριστός, Eph 1:2, al.; ὁ κ. ἡμῶν, I Ti 1:14, He 7:14, al.; id. seq. Ἰησοῦς, I Th 3:11, He 13:20, al.; Χριστός, Ro 16:18; Ἰ Χ., I Co 1:2, I Th 1:3, al.; Ἰ. Χ. (Χ. Ἰ) ὁ κ. (ἡμῶν), Ro 1:4, Col 2:6, Eph 3:11, al.; ὁ κ. καὶ ὁ σωτὴρ, II Pe 3:2; id. seq. Ἰ. Χ., II Pe 3:18; anarth., I Co 7:22, 25, Ja 5:4, al.; κ. κυρίων, Re 19:16; c. prep., ἀπὸ (κατὰ, πρὸς, σὺν, etc.) κ., Col 3:24, al.
SYN: v.s. δεσπότης.

κύων.long: a dog, universally despised in the East.
κύων.as:
κύων, κυνός, ὁ, ἡ
(in NT masc. only), [in LXX forכֶּלֶב;]
a dog: Lk 16:21, II Pe 2:22; metaph., as a word of reproach, Mt 7:6, Phl 3:2, Re 22:15.†

κῦμα.der: from (to swell (with young), i.e. bend, curve);
κῦμα.as:
κῦμα, -τος, τό
(< κύω, to be pregnant, to swell), [in LXX chiefly for גַּל;]
a wave: pl., Mt 8:2414:24, Mk 4:37; κ. θαλάσσης, fig., Ju 13.†
SYN.: κλύδων, q.v.

κυνάριον.long: a little dog, a house dog.
κυνάριον.der: neuter of a presumed derivative of G2965 (κύων);
κυνάριον.as:
* κυνάριον, -ου, τό
(in Att. also κυνίδιον, dim. of κύων),
a little dog: Mt 15:26, 27, Mk 7:27, 28.†

κυλλός.long: crippled, lame, especially in the hands.
κυλλός.sd: rocking about, i.e. crippled (maimed, in feet or hands)
κυλλός.as:
* κυλλός, -ή, -όν,
1.crooked, crippled: Mt 15:30, 31 (WH, txt. om.);
2.maimed: Mt 18:8, Mk 9:43.†

κύμινον.long: cumin, a plant used as a spice.
κύμινον.as:
κύμινον, -ου, τό,
[in LXX: Is 28:25, 27 (כַּמֹּן)*;]
cummin: Mt 23:23.†

Κυρηναῖος.sd: i.e. Cyrenæan, i.e. inhabitant of Cyrene
Κυρηναῖος.as:
Κυρηναῖος, -α, -ον
(< Κυρήνη),
of Cyrene, a Cyrenæan: Mt 27:32, Mk 15:21, Lk 23:26, Ac 6:911:2013:1.†

κύπτω.long: I bend, stoop down, bow the head.
κύπτω.der: probably from the base of G2949 (κῦμα);
κύπτω.as:
κύπτω,
[in LXX chiefly for קדד;]
to bow the head, stoop down: Mk 1:7; seq. κάτω, Jo 8:[6, 8] (cf. ἀνα-, παρα-, συν-κύπτω).†

κύκλῳ.sd: akin to G2947 (κυλιόω)); i.e. in a circle (by implication, of G1722 (ἐν)), i.e. (adverbially) all around
κύκλῳ.der: as if dative case of (a ring, "cycle";
κύκλῳ.as:
κύκλος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for סָבִיב;]
a ring, circle. Dat., κύκλῳ, as adverb., round about, around: Mk 3:346:6, 36, Lk 9:12, Ro 15:19; c. gen., Re 4:65:117:11.†

κυλίομαι.sd: compare G2945 (κύκλῳ), G1507 (εἱλίσσω)); to roll about
κυλίομαι.der: from the base of G2949 (κῦμα) (through the idea of circularity;
κυλίομαι.as:
κυλίω late form of κυλίνδω,
[in LXX: Jos 10:18, I Ki 14:33, al. (גּלל), IV Ki 9:33 (שׁמט), al.;]
to roll, roll along. Pass., to be rolled; of persons (in Hom, as sign of grief), to roll or wallow: Mk 9:20.†

Κυρήνιος.long: Cyrenius or Quirinius, governor of Syria.
Κυρήνιος.as:
Κυρήνιος
(prop. -ίνιος, v. Bl., 13; -ῖνος L, -εῖνος, Tr., WH, mg.), -ου, ὁ,
Quirinus, prop. Quirinius: Lk 2:2.†

κυκλόω.as:
κυκλόω, -ῶ
(< κύκλος), [in LXX chiefly for סבב;]
1.to move in a circle, revolve.
2.to surround, encircle: c. acc. pers., Jo 10:24 (WH, txt., cf. -εύω), Ac 14:20; pass., Lk 21:20, He 11:30 (cf. περι-κυκλόω).†

κυριεύω.kj: have dominion over, lord, be lord of, exercise lordship over
κυριεύω.as:
κυριεύω
(< κύριος), [in LXX chiefly for משׁל;]
to be lord or master of, to rule (over): c. gen. obj., Lk 22:25, Ro 14:9, II Co 1:24; absol., I Ti 6:15; metaph., ὁ θάνατος, Ro 6:9; ἡ ἁμαρτία, Ro 6:14; ὁ νόμος, Ro 7:1 (cf. κατα-κυριεύω).†

Κυρήνη.long: Cyrene, a district west of Egypt on the Mediterranean coast, forming with Crete a Roman province.
Κυρήνη.as:
Κυρήνη, -ης, ἡ,
Cyrene, a city in Libya: Ac 2:10.†

Κύπριος.sd: a Cyprian (Cypriot), i.e. inhabitant of Cyprus

Κύπρος.sd: Cyprus, an island in the Mediterranean
Κύπρος.as:
Κύπρος, -ου, ἡ,
Cyprus: Ac 11:1913:415:3921:327:4.†

κυβερνήτης.long: a steersman, pilot; met: a guide, governor.
κυβερνήτης.as:
κυβερνήτης, -ου, ὁ
(v.s. κυβέρνησις), [in LXX for חֹבֵל, Ez 27:8, 27, 28, Pr 23:24, IV Mac 7:1*;]
1.a steersman, pilot: Ac 27:11, Re 18:17.
2. Metaph., a guide, governor (Eur., Plat.).†

κυριακός.long: of the Lord, special to the Lord.
κυριακός.sd: belonging to the Lord (Jehovah or Jesus)
κυριακός.as:
**† κυριακός, -ή, -όν
(< κύριος), [in LXX: κ. φωνή (Συριακή φ., R), II Mac 15:36 A*;]
1. as freq. in Inscr. (LS, s.v.; Deiss., BS, 217 f.), of the lord or master, imperial.
2.of the Lord (i.e. Christ): δεῖπνον, I Co 11:20; ἡμέρα, Re 1:10. (Cf. λόγια κ., Papias, Eus., HE, iii, 39, 1; γραφαὶ κ., Clem. Alex., etc; for eccl. usage, cf. Soph., Lex., s.v.)†

κυβέρνησις.as:
κυβέρνησις, -εως, ἡ
(< κυβερνάω, Lat. gubernare, to guide), [in LXX: Pr 1:511:1424:6 (תַּחְבֻּלוֹת)*;]
1.steering, pilotage (Plat.).
2. Metaph., government: pl., I Co 12:28.†

κύμβαλον.der: from a derivative of the base of G2949 (κῦμα);
κύμβαλον.as:
κύμβαλον, -ου, τό
(< κύμβη, a cup), [in LXX chiefly for מְצֵלֶת;]
a cymbal: I Co 13:1.†

κυρόω.long: I ratify, confirm, make valid, reaffirm, assure.
κυρόω.as:
κυρόω, -ῶ
(< κῦρος, 1. authority. 2. validity), [in LXX for קום;]
to confirm, ratify, make valid: II Co 2:8; pass., Ga 3:15 (cf. προ-κυρόω).†

κυριότης.long: (a) abstr: lordship, (b) concr: divine or angelic lordship, domination, dignity, usually with reference to a celestial hierarchy.
κυριότης.as:
*† κυριότης, -ητος, ἡ
(< κύριος),
lordship, dominion: Eph 1:21, II Pe 2:10, Ju 8; pl., Col 1:16 (cf. Lft., Col 1:16; Mayor, Ju 8; DB, i, 616 f.).†

κυβεία.long: (lit: playing with dice, gaming, hence) trickery, sleight.

κυλισμός.as:
**† κυλισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(< κυλίω), [in Th.: Pr 2:18*;]
= cl. κύλισις, a rolling, wallowing: II Pe 2:22 (cf. κύλισμα).†

κυρία.as:
κυρία
(Κυρία, T, WH, mg.), -ας, ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for גְּבֶרֶת;]
a lady: II Jo 1, 5 (on the interpretation, v. ICC, 167 ff.).†

κυκλόθεν.long: in a circle round, round about.
κυκλόθεν.sd: from the circle, i.e. all around
κυκλόθεν.der: adverb from the same as G2945 (κύκλῳ);
κυκλόθεν.as:
κυκλόθεν,
adv.,
(< κύκλος), [in LXX chiefly for מִסָּבִיב, סָבִיב;]
from all sides, round about: Re 4:3, 4, 8.†

κυκλεύω.as:
κυκλεύω
(< κύκλος), [in LXX: IV Ki 3:25 B (סבב)*;]
1.to make a circle, go round.
2.to encircle, surround: c. acc. pers., Jo 10:24 (Tr., WH, mg.); c. acc. rei, Re 20:9.†
